fields.Name: C1 -> C2.3
fields.Description: Gate G7.3 (owner PR 1, phase 7, dataset C1, criterion C2.3): on the MoreCheese people behind scenario C1, a second run of the same pipeline version on the same inputs leaves identical value checksums and 0 duplicate rows, and 0 human-entered values are overwritten. Runs the installed job-title pipeline cloned onto a deterministic stub driver over 52 fixture people carrying the 52 golden titles, edits three values by hand between the runs (two seniorities, one job function), and re-runs with the watermark skip off; no model calls.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Run 2 completes under the same pipeline version with 0 failures, identical people / job-function / Feature Value checksums, 0 duplicate Feature Values, and the 3 hand-entered values preserved (HumanValuesPreserved 3).
